title: 快速熱退火
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 退火需求
stages.description: 在「退火需求」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for annealing requirements, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 活化與擴散
steps.objective: 完成「活化與擴散」的因果圖，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate activation and diffusion, connecting relevant limits in temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：活化與擴散。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate activation and diffusion. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「活化與擴散」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate activation and diffusion and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「活化與擴散」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate activation and diffusion: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 活化與擴散的原理
knowledge.text: 活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。
knowledge.textEn: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 擴散長度與時間積分的擴散係數相關，因此短而熱與長而冷的處理不能只用最高溫度排序。
knowledge.textEn: Diffusion length relates to integrated diffusivity, so short-hot and long-cool cycles cannot be ranked by peak temperature alone.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「快速熱退火」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「活化與擴散」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：峰值溫度相同可能有不同熱積分與擴散結果。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「奈米元件整合：閘極到背面供電」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：快速熱退火 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「峰值溫度相同可能有不同熱積分與擴散結果」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Rapid thermal annealing as the task boundary. After reading “Separate activation and diffusion”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Equal peak temperature can hide different thermal histories and diffusion. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Device integration: gate stack to backside power”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Rapid thermal annealing: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Equal peak temperature can hide different thermal histories and diffusion” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 評估「活化與擴散」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate activation and diffusion?
options: 活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。
峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。
化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
optionsEn: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
quiz.explanation: 活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。 擴散長度與時間積分的擴散係數相關，因此短而熱與長而冷的處理不能只用最高溫度排序。
quiz.explanationEn: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. Diffusion length relates to integrated diffusivity, so short-hot and long-cool cycles cannot be ranked by peak temperature alone.

steps.title: 溫度時間軌跡
steps.objective: 完成「溫度時間軌跡」的對照表，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：溫度時間軌跡。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：峰值溫度相同不代表總熱暴露相同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw temperature-time trajectories. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Equal peak temperature does not imply equal thermal exposure. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「峰值溫度相同不代表總熱暴露相同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Equal peak temperature does not imply equal thermal exposure. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「溫度時間軌跡」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw temperature-time trajectories and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「溫度時間軌跡」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for draw temperature-time trajectories: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 熱預算積分
steps.objective: 完成「熱預算積分」的敏感度草圖，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for construct a thermal-budget integral, connecting relevant limits in temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：熱預算積分。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：擴散預算應考慮溫度依賴係數而非只加時間。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂兩段熱歷程：用任意擴散係數 D1=1、D2=4 與時間 t1=4、t2=1 比較 D×t；說明同一擴散積分仍不證明活化或缺陷演化相同。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Construct a thermal-budget integral. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Diffusion budgets need temperature-dependent coefficients, not time alone. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical thermal histories: compare D×t for arbitrary diffusivities D1=1, D2=4 and times t1=4, t2=1. Explain why equal integrated diffusion does not prove equal activation or defect evolution.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「擴散預算應考慮溫度依賴係數而非只加時間。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Diffusion budgets need temperature-dependent coefficients, not time alone. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「熱預算積分」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for construct a thermal-budget integral and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「熱預算積分」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for construct a thermal-budget integral: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.title: 損傷恢復
steps.objective: 完成「損傷恢復」的故障判別表，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for define damage-recovery targets, connecting relevant limits in temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：損傷恢復。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：缺陷修復與摻雜活化可有不同時間尺度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define damage-recovery targets. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Damage repair and dopant activation can have different timescales. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「缺陷修復與摻雜活化可有不同時間尺度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「損傷恢復」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for define damage-recovery targets: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Surface materials change absorption, emission and heat transfer. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
